content.title: American Idol recap: Top 20 sing for America’s vote (Part 1)
content.text: The power shifts this week on American Idol. Judges Carrie Underwood, Lionel Richie, and Luke Bryan have narrowed the competition down to the Top 20, and now it’s up to America to decide who stays and who goes home. The contestants headed to Aulani, A Disney Resort & Spa in Ko Olina, Hawaii, where they perform for viewers’ votes for the first time this season. To help them prepare for the make-or-break round, the hopefuls received guidance from two special mentors: Grammy-winning country singer Brad Paisley and Emmy-winning actress and singer Keke Palmer. Palmer also served as a guest judge during the episode, joining Underwood, Richie, and Bryan at the judges’ table. Lionel Richie, Keke Palmer, Carrie Underwood, and Luke Bryan on Season 24 of 'American Idol.' Disney/Eric McCandless The night also featured a special performance from Season 21 winner Iam Tongi, who sings the title track from his debut album It’s Good for My Soul. He was later joined by Season 23 finalist Thunderstorm Artis for a duet of “Island Style.” How to vote Host Ryan Seacrest announced that the American Idol app has been retired, but fans can still vote for their favorites via text or online — and, for the first time in the show’s history, through social media. Just head to @AmericanIdol on Facebook, Instagram, or TikTok. You can vote up to 10 times per method, per platform — a total of 50 votes for your favorite contestant. Vote for your favorite performance in our poll below — and pick the winner and predict weekly eliminations in Gold Derby’s prediction center. The Performances Makiyah Age: 24Hometown: Pine Bluff, Ark.Performance: "Bang Bang" by Jessie J, Ariana Grande, and Nicki MinajCarrie's comments: "You understood the assignment. You have notes on notes on notes." Luke's comments: "You ain't in Arkansas no more. Your whole presentation was through the roof." Keke's comments: "Talk about a crowd-pleaser." Lionel's comments: "That's how you start a show." Jake Thistle Age: 21Hometown: Paramus, N.J.Performance: "The Power of Love" by Huey Lewis & The NewsCarrie's comments: "You're such an old soul. You looked like you were having fun." Luke's comments: "Every time we see you perform you always look like you're in control. It was fun to see you branch out into rock and roll." Keke's comments: "You're so at home on stage. It felt like a party out here — you saw the girls screaming!" Lionel's comments: "Did I detect 'Sexy Jake'? You're singing your heart out." Genevieve Heyward Age: 26Hometown: Lake Geneva, Wis.Performance: "Pink Pony Club" by Chappell RoanCarrie's comments: "I love that you took a giant pop anthem and toughened it up a little bit. It's fun!" Luke's comments: "Every time you're on stage my eyes find you. I love how you commanded it." Keke's comments: "You're so you. You have such a unique vibe." Lionel's comments: "It almost blew my wig off!" Daniel Stallworth Age: 27Hometown: Moss Point, Miss.Performance: "All Night Long (All Night)" by Lionel RichieCarrie's comments: "Your voice is insane. I see you starting to loosen up — don't think about what you're doing." Luke's comments: "You might be the best singer in this competition." Keke's comments: "I was sad it didn't last all night long." Lionel's comments: "You took the song and made it yours. It was amazing." KyndalAge: 29Hometown: Fishers, Ind.Performance: "Call Your Mom" by Noah KahanCarrie's comments: "The second you start singing it is impossible to turn away. I'm not sure I breathed." Luke's comments: "That cry in your voice is so intoxicating to listen to. I was hanging on every word." Keke's comments: "You transported us into your world — and I loved it there." Lionel's comments: "You delivered a sermon. It was powerful." Kutter BradleyAge: 22Hometown: Florence, Ala.Performance: "It's Not Over" by DaughtryCarrie's comments: "It was such a smart song choice. That song fit perfectly — you're exactly where you're supposed to be." Luke's comments: "Remember to breathe. You're getting better with every performance." Keke's comments: "It was so good to see you lose yourself on stage." Lionel's comments: "That was in your wheelhouse — you were in-pocket and it showed." Jesse FindlingAge: 19Hometown: Massapequa Park, N.Y.Performance: "You Found Me" by The FrayCarrie's comments: "I love that the beginning was a little shaky because you've been so perfect this whole time. It reminded us you're human." Luke's comments: "I was at the edge of my seat." Keke's comments: "As soon as you grabbed the mic and lost yourself in the song — everything after that was perfection." Lionel's comments: "Command the stage. Take charge. You did it! That was fantastic." Hannah HarperAge: 25Hometown: Willow Springs, Mo.Performance: "Ain't No Grave" by Bethel Music & Molly SkaggsCarrie's comments: "Great song choice. Your voice gave me chills the entire time." Luke's comments: "You started a new genre — resurrection rock." Keke's comments: "When you started singing we were locked in. It was excellent!" Lionel's comments: "You went from singing to preaching. You've got our attention." Braden RumfeltAge: 22Hometown: Murphy, N.C.Performance: "Love on the Brain" by RihannaCarrie's comments: "You have an incredible voice. You're so stinkin' good." Luke's comments: "You've got this instrument. Use it to your advantage and keep delivering." Keke's comments: "I love watching you in your flow state. I could tell that you love it and that makes me happy." Lionel's comments: "Check ancestry.com. Whoever they say you are, you are not. That was so soulful it scared me to death." BrooksAge: 22Hometown: Bel Air, Md.Performance: "Dancing on My Own" by RobinCarrie's comments: "He's never done this before. He has not sang in front of people. I am so excited for you. I can't even fathom what you could accomplish." Luke's comments: "Voices like yours don't come along [often]. Trust that people are going to react to your voice in ways that you could never imagine." Keke's comments: "You have one of the most magical voices I've ever heard." Lionel's comments: "I am so glad we know you."
